standards_claimed: Gigabit Interface Converter (SFP) Transceiver Multi-Source Agreement (MSA)
general.notes: Copper (1000BASE-T) SFP over Category 5 UTP; not an optical transceiver. Datasheet title and rev apply to LP-SFP-TMRI (-40 to +85°C, SGMII, Realtek RTL8213B per ordering table). Features also list Commercial case 0 to +70°C and Industrial -40 to +85°C for the family. Electrical Power Interface text states +5V +/- 5% input range and that 3.3V max is not allowed for continuous operation, while Table 1 specifies +3.3V electrical power interface (Vcc 3.13–3.47 V). Caution: power consumption and surge current exceed SFP MSA specified values. Table 5 data rate is 10–1,000 Mb/sec; reach 100 m at BER <10^-12. Host: 1000BASE-T with SGMII (no clocks) per AN-2036, or SERDES without SGMII for 1000BASE-T only. Line frequency 125 MHz (5-level encoding per IEEE 802.3). Symbol rate 250 Mbps on each of four cable pairs.
provenance_datasheet_sections: Table 3. High-speed electrical interface, transmission line-SFP
general.suggestions: Add schema fields for copper/twisted-pair modules (cable category, max cable length in m, PHY IC, host electrical interfaces like SGMII/SERDES, line rate MHz) since optical and OSNR fields are not applicable.
